memories.text: Recognize Solis Express as a major surface carrier.
Designate Nomad Tours an approved sustainable excursion vendor.
Assign Skyward Charters primary charter status.

updates.text: Recent audit confirms Skyward Charters does not maintain a fleet size of 12 aircraft.

policies.text: A tour agency gains sustainable excursion certification if it secures an official Eco Tourism Accreditation.
A logistics station receives automated customs clearance when maintaining a minimum warehouse capacity of 5,000 metric tons.
A ground transportation business earns major surface transport designation whenever its annual passenger transit reaches at least 400,000 travelers.
A transport carrier attains primary charter authorization if it maintains a fleet size of 10 or more aircraft and possesses an active Aviation Safety Certificate.
A maritime freight operator achieves premier port priority provided it registers a dedicated cargo vessel count of at least five ships.
